item.title: Pistons snap Hornets’ 9-game win streak with 110-104 win in game marred by fight, ejections
item.description: Cade Cunningham had 33 points and nine rebounds, and the Detroit Pistons hung on to beat Charlotte 110-104 on Monday night, snapping the Hornets’ nine-game winning streak in a wild game that included a fight and four player ejections.
